name: course-tutor
description: Roster import, learning analytics, participation scores, weekly teaching reports and course version publishing. Teachers connect their own Tencent Docs account straight to their own data hub.

displayDescription.en: CourseTutor: import rosters, aggregate learning analytics, render real-time dashboards, run points gamification, and publish course versions that auto-sync to the student side.
displayDescription.zh: 导入名册、学情归集与可视化看板、积分游戏化，课程资料云端管理，学生端自动同步，一键发布课程版本。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 带我完成首次使用：先做数据中枢与连接自检，再介绍你能帮我做什么。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Walk me through first-time setup: run the data hub self-check, then introduce what you can do for me.

quickPrompts.zh: 带我完成首次使用：先做数据中枢与连接自检，再介绍你能帮我做什么。
quickPrompts.en: Walk me through first-time setup: run the data hub self-check, then introduce what you can do for me.

quickPrompts.zh: 导入本学期名册，录入校历并查看最新学情面板与可视化看板。
quickPrompts.en: Import this semester's roster, enter the school calendar, and show the latest learning analytics panel and dashboard.

quickPrompts.zh: 生成学情可视化看板与积分排行榜，或发布课程新版本给学生。
quickPrompts.en: Generate the learning dashboard and points leaderboard, or publish a new course version to students.
